task.notes: One day ahead (test: two days). E10.5 hearts were dissected and E9.5 embryo portions sectioned, so this transition mixes development with a change in what was sampled (Data Protocol).

floor.what: the organisers' floor: the reference's 10% working copy (copy_last or wt_identity)

copy.what: real reference cells at the count rule

b0.what: B0 (feat-009): T1 chamber-only copy plus damped momentum; T2 copy plus damped momentum or bracket interpolation, both in count space

b0_trend.what: B0 with each lineage's per-gene velocity the least-squares trend of log(mean CP10k + eps) over every input stage where it has min_cells cells, read over B0's time budget (heart only; count space)

b0_trend_quad.what: b0_trend with each lineage's least-squares line replaced by the least-squares quadratic over its usable stages, read as its change from the reference day over b0_trend's budget (heart only; count space)
